title: DOW-UAP-PR36, Unresolved UAP Report, Middle East, May 2020
doc_notes: This document is a declassified Range Fouler Debrief Form from USCENTCOM regarding a UAP sighting in May 2020, containing redactions of personnel and specific location identifiers.

incidents.summary: A solid white object was observed during an ISR mission, exhibiting erratic movements above the water.
incidents.quote: a solid white object flew through the FOV. There was a temporarily lose of the object but re-acquired shortly there after.
